title and abstract.summary: The study investigated how mining activities affect the functional beta diversity of Ephemeroptera nymphs, examining whether pre-served streams have higher functional beta diversity than altered streams and if environmental variation is the main predictor of this diversity across 24 streams in the eastern Amazon.

introduction.summary: The study investigated how mining activities affect functional beta diversity and selected species with specific traits within Ephemeroptera nymphs across 24 streams in the eastern Amazon region.

results.summary: The study measured the functional beta diversity of Ephemeroptera communities across altered and preserved stream environments, analyzing data from 2259 individuals belonging to 27 genera. The study measured functional dissimilarity, turnover, and nestedness for the functional traits of Ephemeroptera in the Carajas National Forest, examining relationships between environmental variables and these traits.
